decisions.reason: The cobot loading system extends the firm's core machining and automation know-how, so its in-house R&D can interpret early results and refine the product in line with its smarter-automation strategy.
The dual-table loading system builds directly on the established machine offer and application knowledge, giving the firm high absorptive capacity to learn from customer feedback and improve it.

Although dispensing lies further from the core offer, the firm's own R&D, existing dispensing activities, flagship positioning and Red Dot award suggest it has enough related knowledge to assimilate market feedback and sustain the product.
